five-call-journey.title: One question, five explicit calls
five-call-journey.description: Read down: find the provider, describe it, resolve the exact selection, query the approved cache, then inspect the query receipt.
steps: Read the query's linked evidence receipt

receipt-linkage.title: Evidence that can be followed
receipt-linkage.description: The query produces an observation and a query receipt. Inspection reads that same receipt and creates a separate inspection receipt.
steps: Names source, policy, warning and content identity
Verify the returned record and content identity
Separate record of the inspection operation

completion-boundaries.title: Do not combine these claims
completion-boundaries.description: Local evaluation is disposable and provider-free. Durable rehearsal is a separate profile. A supported public service needs additional operational and deployment evidence.
steps: Same computer; cached data; disposable receipts
Explicit persistence, restart and restore evidence
Hosting, identity, operations and release acceptance
